roles.name: Villager
roles.description: You have no special powers. Unmask the werewolves through logic and discussion.

roles.name: Seer
roles.description: Every night you may learn the true identity of one player.

roles.name: Witch
roles.description: You have a healing potion that can save a wolf victim and a poison potion that kills a player.

roles.name: Hunter
roles.description: When you die, you may immediately fire one last shot and take any player with you.

roles.name: Cupid
roles.description: On the first night you choose two lovers. If one of them dies, the other dies of a broken heart right away.

roles.name: Bodyguard
roles.description: Every night you protect one player from the wolf attack, but never the same player two nights in a row.

roles.name: Little Girl
roles.description: At night you may secretly peek to watch the werewolves.

roles.name: Elder
roles.description: You survive one extra werewolf attack. But if the village kills you, the village loses its special powers.

roles.name: Bear Tamer
roles.description: You have a bear. If it growls, at least one werewolf is sitting right next to you.

roles.name: Raven
roles.description: Every night you mark one player with raven feathers. They get extra votes against them the next day.

roles.name: Scapegoat
roles.description: If the day vote ends in a tie, you are always the one who dies.

roles.name: Thief
roles.description: At the start of the game you may swap your card for one of the two leftover cards.

roles.name: Werewolf
roles.description: You wake up at night and kill a villager together with the other wolves.

roles.name: Alpha Wolf
roles.description: Once per game you may turn a victim into a werewolf instead of eating them.

roles.name: Big Bad Wolf
roles.description: As long as no werewolf has died, you may eat a second victim every night.

roles.name: Wolfhound
roles.description: On the first night you decide whether you are an ordinary villager or a werewolf.

roles.name: Wild Child
roles.description: You choose a role model. If they die, you become a werewolf.

roles.name: Minion
roles.description: You know the werewolves and help them win. They do not know you, and the Seer sees you as human.

roles.name: White Werewolf
roles.description: You wake up with the wolves, but every second night you may kill one extra victim, even a wolf. You only win if you are the last one alive.

roles.name: Piper
roles.description: At night you enchant players. Once all living players are enchanted, you win alone.

roles.name: Angel
roles.description: If the village lynches you in the very first round, you win at once. Otherwise you become an ordinary villager.
